# Version 4.158.0
> **Rendering fixes and updated shaping** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.158.0-rc.1.26567.14)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.158.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/15.0.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.158.0 previews Skia m158 alongside HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and more reliable filtered rendering. The release candidate adds mask-filtered glyph corrections and tighter antialiased image-subset sampling. HarfBuzzSharp adds 30 named Script constants while retaining its existing Script programming model.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia m158 and HarfBuzz 15** — Advances Skia to milestone 158 with unchanged managed bindings. HarfBuzzSharp moves from the earlier 14.4.0.300 package revision to native HarfBuzz 15.0.0; the revision-only change in Preview 1 did not itself upgrade HarfBuzz. ([#5634](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5634), [#5554](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5554))

## API Surface

- **More named HarfBuzz scripts** — Adds 30 Script fields, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal, completing the selected native script list. Existing fields and values, parsing, numeric conversions and horizontal-direction lookup remain intact; no public Font member is removed. ([#5554](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5554))

## Bug Fixes

- **Image subsets and filter-cache consistency** — AA and MSAA draws retain logical texture bounds and sampling constraints under minification and strong skew, preventing unrelated backing texels from entering filtered output. Image-filter cache equality now compares the same key bytes as hashing, including signed zero and matrix metadata. ([#5768](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5768))
- **Mask-filtered glyphs respect reloaded data** — Rasterizes the reloaded glyph's own path, rejects incompatible or sub-byte mask copies with cleared output, and preserves full image-plane strides for clipped embossed glyphs. This avoids stale outlines, buffer overwrites and uncleared mask planes. ([#5739](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5739))
- **GPU text, hairlines and clip recording** — Reflected zero-length square-capped hairlines keep their device-space size, and text-atlas indices are rounded before sampler selection. Graphite includes pending clip work in render-pass capacity checks and logs and skips draws whose clip stack cannot fit a fresh pass. ([#5669](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5669))
- **Vulkan synchronization and displacement precision** — Native synchronous Vulkan submission incorporates fence-wait failures, while GRContext.Submit remains void. Displacement offsets use fp32 arithmetic to match filter bounds. A targeted cleanup delay handles device-loss paths on affected ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers from version 42 up to, but not including, 56. ([#5712](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5712), [#5669](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5669))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **OS-generated hash seeds** — The shared HashCode polyfill uses OS-generated random bytes rather than System.Random for its per-process seed. Hash codes remain stable within a process and randomized between processes; the first use now initializes cryptography support. — ❤️ [@rolfbjarne](https://github.com/rolfbjarne) ([#5408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5408))

## HarfBuzzSharp 15.0.0

HarfBuzzSharp upgrades the bundled engine to 15.0.0 and adds 30 named Script fields, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal. Existing Script behavior and public Font members remain available; the removed hb_font_set_face import was internal.

## Release Candidate 1 (November 17, 2026)

Release Candidate 1 corrected mask-filtered glyph rasterization and clipped mask-plane handling. It also tightened antialiased image-subset sampling and made image-filter cache equality consistent with hashing.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.158.0-preview.3.26563.17...v4.158.0-rc.1.26567.14)

## Preview 3 (November 13, 2026)

Preview 3 improved displacement-offset precision and native synchronous Vulkan fence-wait reporting, without adding a managed Submit result. The shared HashCode polyfill switched to OS-generated random seeds.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5...v4.158.0-preview.3.26563.17)

## Preview 2 (November 9, 2026)

Preview 2 upgraded native HarfBuzz to 15.0.0 and added 30 named Script fields. GPU fixes covered reflected hairlines, text-atlas selection, Graphite clip capacity and affected ARM Vulkan device-loss cleanup.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2...v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5)

## Preview 1 (November 6, 2026)

Preview 1 introduced Skia m158 without changing managed bindings. HarfBuzzSharp moved to package revision 14.4.0.300 while native HarfBuzz remained at 14.4.0.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.157.0...v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2)
